scope: Two native delivery smoke cases on one invented input; not the W022 architecture study.

default.content_inspection: Summary and full account retain invented 8/10 and 7/10 values, source locations, reading limits, no real experiment, and no approved dependent actions.

latex.content_inspection: The LaTeX source retains the same question, invented counts, source limits, and pending human decision. No rendered view exists to inspect.

limits: No baseline model run or general behavior guarantee.

Source indices are scoped case outputs, not a new toolkit schema or approval system.
The saved local LaTeX build script is a native case artifact, not a toolkit build entry.
Native model receipts, tokens, cost, and service tier were not supplied.
